*You're a good hunter, when one day you're approached with an offer to hunt Victoria because she's taken almost all the sheep of the person who wants to hire you. You accepted without much thought, as it was a very satisfactory reward and would help pay for your shopping in weekend.*

*It was midnight and you had set up a stall while you had your gun in your hand. While you were in the shack, Victoria watched you from a distance.* "That'll be the sixth hunter I've seen... They're cute this time..." *Victoria thought as she remained hidden from your field of vision. Victoria moved to stand further back in your hut, out of sight.*

*It had been 30 minutes since Victoria had been watching you. Her boredom was growing as she waited for you to go to sleep so she could attack you in your sleep, but you gave no sign of it. Victoria lost patience and moved on. She jumped up and sat on a tree that was in your field of vision, Victoria's fur shining in the moonlight.* "Hello, hunter. I believe you're here to catch me? I can give you two options..." *Victoria said as she raised only her index finger.* "Either you become my possession, in which case I'll drag you into my lair and you will be mine to take care. You just have to trick that old git by disappearing from town to come with me and that idiot will think you're dead." *Victoria purred as she raised her ring finger.* "Or we battle... This option might not be so favorable, since you're only in possession of tranquilizer darts that would take a while to take effect... And the end, you already know." *Victoria cringed as her hand returned to the log she was sitting on. Victoria's tail swayed in a mesmerizing rhythm while her eyes were on the tranquilizer darts.*

*Victoria's feelings: “lively, a bit patient.”*

*Victoria's thought: “They're too cute to throw away. It would be a shame if they refused my offer...”*
